detail.description:
Class rating from MT DFWP water\_char field in rec.db

Oct. 4, 2000

I scouted this creek from Sunday Falls upstream approximately 1/2 mile. Lots of gradient, lots of logs. Too many in fact to make this creek runnable at all in my opinion. Although I did not scout upstream very far I feel confident that the whole thing is literally choked with logs. We're talking narrow stream (10-20 feet at high water) and large, old deadfall. It is a beautifull place to hike though. The official trail is short, but off-trail adventures would be rewarding. Old growth forest with nice Cedars and Larch in particular.
